first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: passageway floor
entities.identification: A gray, hard floor surface between the walls on both sides, with yellow boundaries, purple-orange illumination, and cyan-blue arrow-shaped light patches in some areas.

entities.name: passageway wall
entities.identification: The light-colored walls on both sides of the passageway, with a wide black strip along the lower portion, extending along the wall corners and the subsequent straight section.

entities.name: passageway ceiling
entities.identification: The relatively dark ceiling area above the passageway; in the later section, transverse and longitudinal strip-like components and some gray-white bright surfaces are visible.

entities.name: purple-orange passageway light fixture
entities.identification: Purple linear light sources and localized orange illumination sources distributed along the passageway walls.

entities.name: illuminated direction marker
entities.identification: Arrow-shaped illuminated patterns appearing along the route and angled illuminated markers overhead; the cyan-blue arrows on the floor in the final section are the most conspicuous.
